# Longhorn Sim Racing

> Longhorn Sim Racing (LSR) is a student organization at The University of Texas at Austin focused on competitive simulation racing. We host events, run championship series, publish race results, and maintain a community of student drivers.

## About

- Based at The University of Texas at Austin in Austin, Texas, USA
- Competitive sim racing across multiple titles (iRacing, Assetto Corsa, and others)
- Student-run; membership is open to UT Austin students, alumni, and affiliated community members
- Website: https://www.longhornsimracing.org
- Contact: info@longhornsimracing.org

## Key pages

- [Home](https://www.longhornsimracing.org/): Organization overview and featured content
- [About](https://www.longhornsimracing.org/about): Mission, officer team, and history
- [Events](https://www.longhornsimracing.org/events): Upcoming and past race events, practice sessions, meetings
- [Drivers](https://www.longhornsimracing.org/drivers): Active driver roster with profiles and career stats
- [News](https://www.longhornsimracing.org/news): Race reports, announcements, and team updates
- [Lone Star Cup](https://www.longhornsimracing.org/lone-star-cup): Our flagship championship series
- [Gallery](https://www.longhornsimracing.org/gallery): Photos from events and races
- [Sponsors](https://www.longhornsimracing.org/sponsors): Partner organizations supporting LSR
- [Shop](https://www.longhornsimracing.org/shop): Official merchandise
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.longhornsimracing.org/privacy)
- [Terms of Service](https://www.longhornsimracing.org/terms)
